title: Governed database lifecycle and pressure relief contracts

phases.objective: Publish a complete, secret-free, contract-only Spec Kit with deterministic safety boundaries and a multi-PR implementation plan.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The lifecycle contract is complete, bounded, secret-free, and does not authorize runtime mutation.
steps: Load the Spec 019 documents and JSON schemas.
Verify lifecycle stages, domain decisions, authority boundaries, receipts, readback, and error taxonomy.
Reject arbitrary SQL, wildcard authority, silent retention, and destructive defaults.
assertions: Engine runs remain plan-only when retention policy is missing.
Logical cleanup and physical reclaim are separate contracts.
No secrets or Production mutation authority are included.

phases.objective: Implement read-only pressure observation plus Track B authority/receipt/readback readiness, bounded non-production TTL rehearsal, supersession classification, and migration checksum/readback preflight without database mutation.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The observer receives pressure metrics, domain classifications, policy coverage, and immutable review plans while write and execution authority remain absent.
steps: Load bounded table and capacity observations through SELECT-only adapters.
Classify registered and unknown database resources by domain semantics.
Resolve approved policy metadata or return a blocking result and immutable plan.
assertions: Unknown retention and missing policy fail closed.
The collector remains SELECT-only with will_write=false and will_execute=false.

e2e_journeys.actor: Track B database lifecycle readiness reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: databaseLifecycleMutationReadiness, migrationReadinessManifest, and Track B evidence manifests
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Exact authority/approval/lease/receipt/readback evidence, bounded TTL rehearsal, supersession classification, and pinned 012/1043 migration preflight can be validated deterministically while Final Authority, execution, migration apply, database mutation, provider invocation, runtime consumers, and Production mutation remain disabled.
steps: Validate exact database_table resource authority evidence, registered recipe identity, plan fingerprint, capability envelope, execution lease, typed approval, and expiry without granting Final Authority.
Require durable receipt persistence, idempotency, unknown-outcome reconciliation, and same-cycle authoritative readback before any future retry.
Build immutable-cutoff response-chunk TTL dry-run batches that preserve non-expired and post-plan rows and keep physical reclaim observation-only.
Classify repository-audit supersession only for completed-parent, strictly newer same-file observations and reject concurrent newer observations until re-read and re-plan.
Verify pinned checksum, source identity, statement count, ledger, expected objects, and same-cycle readback contracts for the existing 012 connection-ownership migration and Migration 1043.

Verify the Track B handoff keeps job runner, autopilot, archive/thin, physical reclaim execution, provider calls, runtime consumers, migration apply, database mutation, and Production mutation disabled.
assertions: Track B consumes authority evidence but does not grant Final Authority.
Wildcard or unknown resources, expired evidence, missing receipts/readback, and Production environment requests fail closed.
Unknown outcomes never permit blind retry.
No live non-production TTL or supersession database mutation is executed by this phase.
F/G/H/I execution follow-ups remain separate or disabled.
migration_applied=false and database_mutated=false remain explicit in the handoff evidence.

phases.objective: Run separately authorized live reconciliation and preservation-invariant failure testing before any execution surface is enabled.
Run a separately authorized response-chunk live non-production pilot with fixed cutoff, receipts, same-cycle readback, and rollback evidence.
Promote only after staging/canary/readback, security, performance, migration, owner approval, and Track A Final Authority gates.
